[spoiler=The Sea Turned Red][b]July 13, 2026[/b]

[b][i]7:39[/i][/b]

The ships were raided. Every person who tried to resits was shot on sight. Hatzur's personal "body guards" as they were called, took hold of the guns, firing on the Wessernian shore with no remorse, no care for the friendly fire, no care for how many of their own they were killing.

[i]BOOM[/i]! Many people were woken by the first bombardment, but now people were scared, the second one was stronger, closer, and almost angrier. But what was worse than the shells hitting the shore was the screams. People would latter recite that the screams were horrible, like the souls from the Unhelwo, the Underworld, were screaming out for them. But then the screams stopped. Those who survived the beach now had access to the entire island, or so they thought. At first people hid, scared of the bloody and battered men with angry, hostile faces, but it was when one man, the retired veteran Kaziatio "Crazy Kazzy" Drevito took up arms and fought back. Him and his buddies were going for morning coffee in Wessernia when the invasion began, at first nobody knew what was happening, that's when the coffee shop started to shake. It was very close to the shore and was one of the buildings with access panels to the concealed guns, which were fully put out of action by the second bombardment. Thinking it was an earthquake, Kazzy and everyone in he coffee shop ran outside. Only seconds later was the shore gun connected to the coffee shop hit with a shell, the fire went into the magazines and exploded, luckily everyone escaped before then. By that time the sirens had gone off, it was a full invasion, thus Kazzy ran to his house and grabbed his service gun. He and his friends managed to fend off the soldiers from Main & Veterans for a solid hour before running out of ammo. By that time word had spread that people were fighting back, eventually there were hundreds of citizens fighting back. Luckily the armed forces and the CPG (Citizens Protection Group) and WNG (Wessernian National Guard) were able to start fighting back, and eventually their hard work payed off, Guhui'Bernardio's forces were stopped, but the front line was weak, and they had limited supplies. Where the army, marines, and air force were there was a gain of ground for Western View, but where it was more CPGs and less supplied troops, there was a standstill or a slow of Guhui'Bernardio's advance. Unfortunately, more of Hatzur's troops started landing, and the bombardment had finally been ordered to stop.

[b][i]12:56[/i][/b]

The front lines were moving towards the capital, luckily the troops that had landed there were met with most of the military, but that meant that elsewhere there were not as many troops. If there was a map showing the front lines and there movement it would be chaos. Chaos. That's what the island of Wessernia had been turned into, misinformation, bullets flying everywhere, friendly fire, downed radios, there is not a better word for the "Battle of Wessernia", as it was starting to be called. The battle ragged through city streets, jungles, fields, even across "rivers" and "lakes", but as the battle raged, there was one thing the Wessernians were unaware of a helicopter landing in Wessernia, no one knew or cared that the leaders of this operation, Hatzur Zatsugi and his generals, were touching Wessernian soil for the first time in a year.[/spoiler]

[b]Congress of the EOIC Held in Makkah[/b]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم [/i]

[insert whatever the heck the date is in RP here lol]

Delegates from the participating states of the EOIC met in Makkah to vote on the final draft of the Constitution, elect a Secretary-General, discuss the situation in Valderra, establish economic agreements with one another, and establish military and defense cooperation. The opening speech was given by the Baladullahan head representative to the Congress, Umar al-Maghlabi.

Bismillah ir Rahman ir Raheem, salaamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, wa salli alaa sayyidina Muhammad wa alaa alihi wa sah-bihi wa sellim.

I begin in the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful, and I greet you all with the peace and blessings of Allah, and a special duaa for the final Prophet, Muhammad (salallahu alayi wa sellim) that Allah may give him extra peace and blessings and also give those to his family and companions. Ameen. Amma bad (to begin):

We are gathered in this holy and blessed city of Makkah al-Muharram today to open a new chapter in friendly relations between our nations on the basis of the Quran, the Sunnah, and upholding the unity of the people of community on the basis of the Sunnah (Ahl as-Sunnah wal Jamaah), which Muhammad (saws) told us as Muslims to be a part of. This doesnt just mean the Sunni Muslims, it applies to all Muslims. 

We also extend the olive branch of peace and harmony to all non-Muslims of our countries and the world, and we seek co existence on the basis of respect, dignity, and the principle of for us our religion and for you your religion. We wish to build bonds of solidarity and community on the basis of being from Bani Adam (the family of Adam aka humanity), and we only have a problem with those non-Muslims who seek to attack us, force us out of our religions, persecute us, or support others in doing so. By the same token, we staunchly oppose any and all Muslims who persecute, oppress, attack, or seek to forcefully convert non-Muslims, and especially extremists who carry out cowardly acts of terrorism to further their hateful agenda.

On that note, we condemn the Islamic State of Valddera in the harshest terms possible, and denounce them as extremists who are violating the core principles of the religion they claim to follow, Islam. We offer both our condolences and prayers to the people of Valderra, and also real, material support with humanitarian aid, military aid, and anything they need to defeat these violent radicals. In shaa Allah there will be peace and rebuilding there soon.

We also propose an economic cooperation agreement of some kind between all the participants in EOIC, to encourage free and fair trade between all countries and so that wealthier nations can assist poorer nations, and so that investment and exchange can happen unhindered between all EOIC nations.

Finally, we propose a military intelligence sharing system and establishing a joint military command center for all EOIC nations solely for mutual defense and so all of us can have the same level of military technology. We dont necessarily think this should be a defense pact per se, but are open to that as well in shaa Allah.

We hope and pray this can be the beginning of a strong and beneficial relationship between all the nations, and a way for us to live as Muslims on the basis of the Quran and the Sunnah, and to live as fellow human beings with one another on the basis of peace, solidarity, respect, and mutual respect and co existence, in shaa Allah. [/spoiler]

[b][u]Statement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs[/u][/b]

The government of President Fereydun Khan of Dhornaper has signed a trade and border agreement with the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah. We believe that this trade agreement is very beneficial for both sides and will allow our Shamatine brother to have safe, secure, and reliable access to international waters through the proposed dry port connected to the port of Shar.

[Quote=Agreement;1][b]Dhornaper-Baladullah Trade and Border Agreement[/b]

Article 1 - Borders

1.1. Both parties agree to permit each other's Citizens to travel to each other's countries for tourism without requiring a visa for 90 days within a 180 day window.

1.1.1. A Citizen of a party can be forbidden from travel if they have committed or intend to commit an offence in the other party's country.

1.2. Both sides agree to allow the free flow of goods and services across each other's borders.

Article 2 - Trade

2.1. Both sides agree to not levy tariffs against each other.

2.2. The Republic of Dhornaper agrees to allow the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah to build a dry port on the outskirts of Shar.

2.2.1. The land for the dry port will be chosen by the Republic of Dhornaper and the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah must pay for the cost of the land.

2.2.2. The dry port must be constructed by companies incorporated in the Republic of Dhornaper and funded by the Islamic Sultanate of Baladullah.

2.2.3. The Islamic Sultante of Baladullah must employ citizens of the Republic of Dhornaper for the operation of the dry port.

2.2.4. The Republic of Dhornaper will construct the necessary road and railway infrastructure necessary to transport goods to the dry port and to the port of Shar which must be paid for by the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah.

2.2.5. The Republic of Dhornaper will not charge a fee for the operation of the dry port nor impose any additional fees other than what exist in law for all other goods for any goods being exported by the Sultante of Baladullah.

2.2.6. All goods exported by the Islamic Sultante of Baladullah must be declared to the Republic of Dhornaper as it enters the border and any goods that would be illegal in the Republic of Dhornaper require authorisation before they can enter.

2.2.7. All legal goods must be permitted entry without obstruction.[/quote]

---

Signed,
Jalayer Khan, Minister of Foreign Affairs
